internal_measurement.results: The release-mode USI binary was rebuilt from commit c3e61de. Release tests, Clippy, formatting, documentation, release metadata, and a deterministic USI smoke passed locally. A pre-fixed local self-play SPRT against the previous search defaults used 0.5 seconds per move, one thread, six parallel games, balanced openings, Elo0=0, Elo1=10, and alpha=beta=0.05; it accepted H1 at 239-139-16 over 394 games with LLR +3.03. This is scoped local evidence, not a general strength claim.

external_opponents.configuration: Independent local one-thread and fixed-node comparisons against YaneuraOu moved in the same direction as self-play, but they are not used as a general external-engine superiority claim. Four-thread evidence remains inconclusive.

known_limitations: Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The adopted history defaults passed the one-thread local gate; four-thread evidence remains inconclusive.
No general playing-strength or external-engine superiority claim is made for this release.
No NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted; the optional v0.3.38 checkpoint and its material-baseline recommendation remain unchanged.
External HalfKP 256x2-32-32 inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
